description.narrative: The expansion of Community Based Maternal and Perinatal Surveillance and Review in Baitadi district and strengthening of quality newborn care services in 12 hospitals (in Province 1, 3, 4, 5, 6, and 7) are the major highlights in 2017. | Status:On-track | As-of Date:31/12/2017

title.narrative: % of birthing centres in priority districts providing services for managing new born complications as per National Standards

actual.value: 2017:50 per cent of birthing centers are equipped with newborn corners.

title.narrative: % of children (disaggregated by age and gender) with diarrhoea treated with Zinc and ORS in 15 priority districts

actual.value: 2017:90 per cent of children under five with diarrhoea had received oral rehydration solution (ORS) and zinc for treatment.

title.narrative: % HIV-infected pregnant women and adolescent girls (disaggregated by age) who received ARV drugs to reduce the risk of MTCT in 8 (PMTCT) out of 15 priority districts

actual.value: 2017:64% pregnant women living with HIV received ARV drugs to reduce the risk of mother to child transmission. (UNAIDS report 2017)
